title: CARLA: Adjusted common average referencing for cortico-cortical evoked potential data
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG recordings from four patients undergoing single pulse electrical stimulation, collected to develop and validate CARLA (Adjusted Common Average Referencing for cortico-cortical evoked potential data). The study addresses methodological challenges in reference electrode selection for intracranial recordings and provides raw data supporting the development of improved signal processing techniques for cortico-cortical evoked potentials.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG data were collected from patients at rest during single pulse electrical stimulation delivered at approximately 0.2 Hz frequency. Stimulation parameters included 200 microsecond duration, biphasic waveform, and 6 mA amplitude. Data are formatted according to BIDS version 1.14.0.
